name: ZAdPro MicroFin
tagline: Easy & Secure Loan & Microfinance Management System
shortDescription: Comprehensive microfinance platform enabling field agents and clients to handle loan applications, risk assessment, approvals, and repayment management with top-grade security.
fullDescription: ZAdPro MicroFin is a state-of-the-art loan management and microfinance operating system. Designed for financial institutions, NBFCs, and credit cooperatives, it streamlines field agent operations, loan origination, client verification, repayment tracking, and automated interest calculations. Customers get a mobile-friendly dashboard to track active loans, apply for new credit, and make instant digital repayments.
features: Field Agent Mobile App with offline sync
Automated Credit Scoring & KYC verification
Flexible Loan Repayment Schedules & Interest Calculators
Razorpay & Multi-gateway Payment Integration
Comprehensive Audit Trails & Financial Compliance Reports
Real-time SMS & Email Notification Alerts

name: ZAdPro Yoke
tagline: All-in-One Solution for Educational Institution Management
shortDescription: Simplify student management, online classes, fee collection, and administrative coordination with 6 dedicated role portals.
fullDescription: ZAdPro Yoke is an enterprise-grade ERP designed specifically for schools, colleges, and polytechnics. With custom portals for Super Admin, Principal, Teachers, Students, Parents, and Accountants, Yoke automates attendance tracking, gradebook generation, exam schedules, online fee collection with instant receipts, and bus tracking.
features: 6 Tiered Admin Roles (SuperAdmin, Staff, Student, Parent, Finance, Transport)
Automated Fee Collection & Online Payment Gateway (Razorpay)
Digital Gradebooks, Report Card Generator & Exam Scheduler
Live Attendance Tracking via Biometric & Mobile QR
Interactive Parent-Teacher Messaging & Circular Announcements
Library & Inventory Management Module

name: ZAdPro Indhaa
tagline: One-Stop Hub for Food, Instamart Groceries, Travel & Parcel Delivery
shortDescription: SuperApp platform linking customers, merchants, and delivery partners for hyper-local commerce, travel, and logistics.
fullDescription: ZAdPro Indhaa empowers multi-vendor ecosystems by consolidating food ordering, grocery delivery, ride hailing, and package courier services into a single unified mobile experience. Includes live GPS tracking, dynamic fare calculation, merchant store manager, and instant vendor payouts.
features: Hyper-local Food & Grocery Ordering Ecosystem
Live Delivery Agent Tracking & Automated Route Dispatching
Intercity & Local Parcel Express Booking
Merchant Inventory Management & Order Acceptance Console
Built-in Customer Loyalty Wallet & Discount Coupon Engine
Multi-language Support for Regional Reach

name: ZAdPro Express Logistics
tagline: Optimize Parcel Booking, Fleet Dispatching & Real-Time Tracking ERP
shortDescription: Enterprise logistics software for parcel booking, hub manifest creation, driver dispatch, and automated barcode scanning.
fullDescription: ZAdPro Express Logistics is an end-to-end transport and parcel management ERP built for courier companies, logistics providers, and freight handlers. Automate branch bookings, print thermal labels, manage hub-to-hub manifests, calculate weight-based pricing, and provide customers with live parcel status tracking.
features: Consignment Booking & Thermal Barcode Label Generation
Hub-to-Hub Transport Manifest & Vehicle Load Planning
Driver Delivery Mobile App with Digital Proof of Delivery (POD)
Automated Weight, Volume & Distance Price Matrix
Customer Self-Service Tracking Portal & WhatsApp Alerts
Fleet Maintenance, Fuel Cost & Driver Commission Accounting

name: MedPredit
tagline: Track. Assess. Improve. Your Family Digital Health Companion
shortDescription: AI-powered wellness assessment, chronic condition tracking, and preventive health insights for individuals and corporate wellness.
fullDescription: MedPredit is a modern digital health platform leveraging AI algorithms to assess health metrics, monitor lifestyle habits, manage chronic conditions, and predict health risk factors. It allows users to store lab reports securely, connect smart wearable devices, and receive personalized preventive health advice.
features: AI Health Risk Calculator & Predictive Wellness Assessment
Secure Encrypted Health Record Vault (HIPAA Compliant)
Smart Wearable Integration (Apple Health, Fitbit, Google Fit)
Vitals Tracking (Blood Pressure, Glucose, BMI, Heart Rate)
Family Health Profiles & Emergency SOS Beacon
Teleconsultation & Doctor Appointment Booking
